title: Better Dyeing
description: Universal dyeing! Dye any block of any color!
body:
# Better Dyeing
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack allows you to dye colored blocks in a crafting table no matter what color they are! Normally you can only dye plain Glass into Stained Glass, but now you can dye eight Red Stained Glass into any color you like!
## Affected Blocks & Block Groups
- Sand and Red Sand
- Ochre, Pearlescent, and Verdant Froglights
- Banners
- Candles
- Concrete
- Concrete Powder
- Glazed Terracotta
- Stained Glass
- Stained Glass Panes
- Terracotta
## Recipes Added
Whether recipes are shaped or shapeless varies by recipe :) For this pack, every recipe that uses all nine slots are shaped, while the rest are shapeless.
## IMPORTANT
> This includes **Sand**, **Red Sand**, and **Froglights** which are not normally dyeable!
## More
I haven't figured out a good way to make modular datapacks, so don't be afraid to go into the file and delete any .json files in the [recipe] folder you don't want!

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
